messages:
kai: starting a targeted canary for kernel-quant v3.2. plan: us-west-2 5% for 20m with lowered concurrency and thermal hysteresis. will watch p50/p95, OOMs, kv-cache-hit, and gpu temps.
ash: ack. i'll pin matmul-legacy standby for the window (pin_id=pin-8801 ttl=2h). keep rollback commands handy.
maria: drafting a short blurb for release notes now. adding changelog entry about int8 matmul selection and kv-cache robustness fixes.
sam: can we bump telemetry sampling for canary to capture per-model token latency and kv hit ratio? want traces for any model with >1s tail.
deploy-bot: PRECHECKS:
``ncompat-check: PASS
pack-checksum: PASS
smoke: PASS (staging)
telemetry-hook: ON
rollout: r-1747-kq32
``nops-sre: saw intermittent thermal climbs in west cluster last night. recommend concurrency 60% and hysteresis: pause if gpu_temp_median > 86C for 3m. also announce to oncall.
kai: updated plan: concurrency -> 60%, thermal pause -> 86C@3m, fallback = v3.1-legacy.
ash: pin applied: pin-8801 region=us-west-2 ttl=2h reason=rollback-hotpath.
release-bot: draft created -> https://docs.internal/releases/kernel-quant-3.2 (maria please review)
maria: edited draft with rollback criteria: any OOMs during canary OR p50 regression >10% OR p95 >15% => immediate rollback.
sam: telemetry toggles: token-lat-p50/p95, kv-cache-hit-rate, gpu-temp-percentiles enabled for canary.
deploy-bot: executing step1 -> us-west-2 slice=5% concurrency=60% id=r-1747-kq32-step1
kai: watch first 10 minutes closely. ping me if any latency/ooms.
ops-sre: oncall notified. if thermal flap, we should trigger quickpin and drain new nodes.
ash: quick rollback snippet (tested):
``ncli rollout pin --region us-west-2 --pin-id pin-8801 --duration 2h
cli rollout swap --rollout-id r-1747-kq32 --to-version v3.1-legacy
``nsam: small jitter at t+7m on staging histograms, but prod canary looks normal so far.
deploy-bot: metrics t+12m -> p50 +3%, p95 +2%, kv-cache-hit steady, OOMs=0, gpu_temp_median=79C.
maria: within thresholds, keeping release note live. will finalize after step2.
kai: proceed to 15m then evaluate for 25% spread across west regions staggered 5m apart.
ops-sre: annotate any thermal flickers in incident board and keep drain hooks ready.
deploy-bot: STEP1 COMPLETE -> STABLE. scheduling step2 in 8m: increase to 25% across us-west-2 then us-west-1 staggered.
release-bot: interim note posted to #eng-release-notes: "kernel-quant v3.2 canary step1 stable, proceeding to step2"
ash: leaving legacy pin active until rollout fully completes.
kai: nice work. keep messages concise here unless critical. if rollback occurs, include pin id and short reason in the thread.
ops-sre: standing by for hotpatch decisions.
